messages.subject: Large Text Box
parts:
I need to make a large text input box so a user can enter a few sentences. How do I do this? 

I don't see a height option here. textInput(inputId, label, value = "", width = NULL, placeholder = NULL)

How do I make it taller?

Thanks,

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Large Text Box
parts:
It sounds like you want to support multiple lines. I don't think a text input has the ability to have multiple lines. Instead, there's an HTML input called textarea (instead of text) that allows multiple lines.  Since it's not a default input of shiny, you have to access it using the tags$ object.

Add this line to your UI

tags$textarea(id = "text", rows = "10", cols = "50")  # text input with 10 rows aka lines
